<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that in the forward direction converts a ketone and a C‑C double bond into an aliphatic hydroxyl (alcohol) and a new C‑C single bond – i.e., the carbonyl‑ene reaction. The template catalog expects functional‑group names from its predefined list, so we specify “ketones” and “C‑C double bonds” as the groups broken and “aliphatic hydroxyls” as the group formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
